qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology or Post Graduate Degree in Science (Computer Science, MCA) or Engineering with formal training on IT/Computer Systems. Minimum 60% marks required.
qualification.details: Bachelor's Degree from a minimum NAAC 'A' accredited university/college in Computer Science / Information Technology with a minimum of 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Science (Computer Science, MCA or equivalent) / Engineering with formal training on IT / Computer Systems with a minimum of 60% marks. At least 5 years of post-qualification experience in IT / CT System implementation and analysis. Expertise in MS Office database management software and webpage designing / website development or coding in Java / .NET or equivalent programming languages.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CEPI Project Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://www.mha.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CEPI Project Manager (IT) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form for the CEPI Project Manager (IT) recruitment is 28th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager (IT) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology or a Post Graduate Degree in Science (Computer Science, MCA) or Engineering with formal training on IT/Computer Systems, securing a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Manager (IT) position is 45 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for specific categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager (IT) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Manager (IT) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 72,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager (IT) post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Project Manager (IT) position in this recruitment drive by CEPI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the CEPI Project Manager (IT) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Manager (IT) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Manager (IT) post will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to this post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Manager (IT) position is a contractual job, meaning the appointment will be for a fixed tenure.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is New Delhi, Delhi, with a pincode of 110001.
